enrich_bugs.symptom: metrics.energy is hardcoded {kwh_nominal: null, peak_load_kw: null, notes: 'DAE channel: no attribute dictionaries, not derivable'} even for sketchup channel with full metadata.energy
enrich_bugs.evidence: out_slim_v5.json shows energy=null, but source has battery_main_630ah_lfp (630Ah * 24V = 15.12 kWh), battery_secondary_100ah_lfp (2.4 kWh), inverter_hybrid_3_2kw (3.2 kW). Total 17.52 kWh.
enrich_bugs.impact: LLM cannot see house has 17.5 kWh battery capacity + 3.2 kW inverter. Blocks energy analysis.
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Read metadata.energy.{capacity_ah, nominal_voltage_v, rated_power_kw} per node. Sum kWh = sum(cap*volt/1000). Peak = max(rated_power_kw). Set notes based on channel and whether metadata was found.

enrich_bugs.symptom: Regex '^kamna' no longer matches 'stove_01_wood' after v1.1 rename. Clearance rule broken. brief.facts.narrowest_passage_mm = null, metrics.free_space.passages = [].
enrich_bugs.evidence: v7 had stove-bed: 642.4 mm passage; v1.2 has none because regex needs 'kamna' but node name is 'stove_01_wood'.
enrich_bugs.impact: Missing clearance info in brief. LLM cannot say 'stove is 642mm from bed, OK'.
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Option 1: add alias '^(kamna|stove)' / '^(bed|postel)' to rules.json. Option 2 (preferred): role-based rules: match metadata.cad2llm.role instead of regex. Option 3: add vocab aliases kamna->stove.

enrich_bugs.symptom: When no role=floor node exists, free_space falls back to envelope bbox, giving free_ratio=0.886 (nonsensical for 10 m² room with 4 m² furniture). cells_total=3600 (60x60) but floor_area=10.37 m².
enrich_bugs.evidence: v1.2 has no 'floor_m2' node; only insulation_floor_100 (role=insulation, assembly=floor). v7 had floor_m2 (role=floor).
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Fallback chain: role=floor -> role=insulation with assembly=floor -> null with note. Or use space_boundary_room_01 footprint (but it's 23.5 m², wrong). Best: derive from insulation_floor_100 bbox, subtract furniture.

enrich_bugs.symptom: space_boundary_room_01 (zero-thickness 2D annotation) pollutes adjacency relations (~8 of 32). E.g., stove adjacent to space_boundary at 150mm.
enrich_bugs.evidence: out_slim_v5.json relations include: 3349@stove_01_wood -> 3377@space_boundary (150mm), 3353@battery -> space_boundary (74mm), 3357@wall -> space_boundary (74mm), etc.
enrich_bugs.impact: Adjacency count inflated (32 vs expected ~24). LLM may misinterpret spatial relationships.
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Exclude roles [space_boundary, boundary, void] from adjacency/contact kinds in build_relations(). Keep only for containment if at all.

enrich_bugs.symptom: 4880@Unnamed (definition 'Stove pipe') has role=stove, zone=sleep via tag fallback. Should be role=duct or role=chimney, zone=envelope.
enrich_bugs.impact: LLM may confuse stove pipe with stove.
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Annotate in model: cad2llm.role=duct, zone=envelope, ifc.type=IfcPipeFitting. Add 'duct'/'chimney' to core vocab.

enrich_bugs.symptom: 3635@Unnamed (definition 'bed_frame') has no metadata.cad2llm/ifc, only tag fallback role=bed, confidence 0.7. definition_description is null.
enrich_bugs.impact: LLM has low-confidence role, definitions[] entry missing metadata.

enrich_bugs.symptom: enrich output grew 359 -> 423 KB (+18%) because geometry block is preserved. Not a bug (additive by design), but inefficient for handoff.
enrich_bugs.impact: Enrich on geometry export is wasteful. Not blocking because slim drops geometry anyway.
enrich_bugs.fix_sketch: Add --drop-geometry flag to enrich. Then v5 ~140 KB instead of 423 KB. Optional optimization.

decision_log.rationale: Keeps concerns separated. Enrich = deterministic semantic layer (v4->v5). Slim = compression layer (v5->slim). User can run either independently.
decision_log.consequence: Slim on v4 has no relations/metrics/brief (correct, they don't exist in v4).

decision_log.rationale: Design chat doesn't need mesh. Geometry is 318/359 KB (88%). Drop by default, keep via --geometry summary or --geometry keep.
decision_log.consequence: Slim default output 45 KB vs 423 KB v5. But no collision analysis without --geometry keep.

decision_log.rationale: For design chat, role/zone/system suffice. Energy/fire analysis needs --keep-domain-dicts.
decision_log.consequence: Same file, two use cases, explicit flag.

decision_log.rationale: One representation, not two. Avoids duplicity. Euler is readable but loses precision; quaternion is precise.
decision_log.consequence: Slim outputs quaternion only for non-identity rotations. --rotation euler switches.

decision_log.rationale: 46 instances share 28 definitions. Sending metadata 46x is waste.
decision_log.consequence: definitions[] table + nodes reference by definition_name. If two instances have conflicting metadata (rare, annotation mistake), first instance wins (deterministic by source order).

decision_log.decision: Do NOT fix enrich bugs in slim
decision_log.rationale: Bugs A-D are in enrich, not in slim. Slim faithfully reflects enrich output.
decision_log.consequence: Slim on buggy v5 output will show energy=null. Fix in cad2llm_v5.py, then re-enrich.

slim: On v4 input, metrics/relations/brief are absent (they are v5 artifacts). Run enrich first for full handoff.
Definitions use ASCII sort ('Stove pipe' before 'battery_base_shelf'). Deterministic but may surprise humans.
Two instances of same definition with different metadata: first wins. No merge logic.
If neither quaternion nor rotation_deg present in spatial (rare), no rotation emitted.
enrich: Bug B: clearance regex broken after rename.
Bug C: free_space fallback wrong when no role=floor.
Bug G: enrich preserves geometry (wasteful but not wrong).
pipeline: SketchUp is single-threaded Ruby; bridge must dispatch via UI.start_timer.
SU 2024 = Ruby 3.2.2; SU 2027 = Ruby 3.4.9 (future upgrade path).
DAE channel is legacy fallback; sketchup channel is primary.
